method: breaths by loudness (under -20 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 6 of 7 breaks heard

lines.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis: sanctificétur nomen tuum;
lines.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name;

lines.latin: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra.
lines.english: Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

lines.latin: Panem nostrum quotidiánum da nobis hódie;
lines.english: Give us this day our daily bread;

lines.latin: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris;
lines.english: and forgive us our trespasses as we forgive those who trespass against us;

lines.latin: et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem.
lines.english: and lead us not into temptation,
